zh.title: 義大利陸軍 CH-47 直升機波黑訓練墜毀 4 死 11 傷
zh.summary: 義大利 CH-47 訓練墜毀 4 死 11 傷；原因未明，義方與 EUFOR 同步調查
body: 義大利國防部表示，一架隸屬歐盟 EUFOR Althea 任務的義大利陸軍 CH-47 直升機於 2026 年 10 月 29 日在波士尼亞赫塞哥維納東北部布爾奇科附近的戈裏采地區墜毀，機上 15 人中造成 4 死 11 傷。
死者包括兩名義大利陸軍航空兵與兩名義大利紅十字軍事志願軍團成員；11 名傷者均無生命危險，義方已派醫療小組支援。
EUFOR 證實墜機發生於例行訓練，地點位於布爾奇科區戈裏採，距薩拉熱窩約 180 公里，且未造成平民傷亡或財產損失。
事發原因尚未釐清，義大利國防部與 EUFOR 分別展開調查；義大利駐波黑大使向媒體表示，事故疑似發生於起飛階段。
直升機於 10 月 28 日上午自維泰博起飛，經普拉蒂卡迪馬雷空軍基地轉飛波黑。義大利陸軍自 2009 年起訂購 16 架 ICH-47F，首批已於 2014 年交付第 1 航空團。

en.title: Italian Army CH-47 Chinook crashes during EUFOR training in Bosnia, four dead, eleven injured
en.summary: CH-47 crashes in Bosnia training; four dead, eleven injured; investigations underway
body: The Italian Ministry of Defence reported that an Italian Army CH-47 Chinook assigned to the EUFOR Althea mission crashed near Brčko, Bosnia and Herzegovina, on 29 October 2026, killing four personnel and injuring eleven others.

The four fatalities comprised two Italian Army aviation crew members and two members of the Italian Red Cross Military Volunteer Corps; the eleven injured are receiving treatment with none in life‑threatening condition, and an Italian medical team has been dispatched.
EUFOR confirmed the helicopter went down during routine training in the Gorice area of the Brčko District, about 180 kilometres from Sarajevo, with no civilian casualties or property damage.

The cause remains undetermined; both the Italian Ministry of Defence and EUFOR have launched separate investigations, and Italy’s ambassador to Bosnia said the accident appeared to have occurred during take‑off.

The aircraft departed Viterbo on 28 October, stopped at Pratica di Mare Air Base, then continued to Bosnia. The Italian Army ordered 16 ICH‑47F Chinooks in 2009, with the first two delivered to the 1st Army Aviation Regiment ‘Antares’ in Viterbo in 2014.

facts.claim: Four Italian military personnel were killed and eleven injured when an Italian Army CH-47 Chinook crashed near Brčko, Bosnia and Herzegovina on October 29, 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: Four Italian military personnel were killed, and a further 11 injured, when an Italian Army CH-47 Chinook crashed near Brčko, in northeastern Bosnia and Herzegovina, on October 29, 2026.

facts.claim: The helicopter was assigned to the European Union’s EUFOR Althea mission.
facts.sourceQuote: The helicopter was assigned to the European Union’s EUFOR Althea mission.

facts.claim: Fifteen people were on board; two fatalities were Italian Army members and two were from the Italian Red Cross Military Volunteer Corps.
facts.sourceQuote: In a statement released the same day, the Italian Ministry of Defense said that 15 people were on board. Two of the casualties were from the Italian Army and two from the Italian Red Cross Military Volunteer Corps, an auxiliary corps of the Italian armed forces.

facts.claim: The eleven injured are receiving treatment with none in life‑threatening condition; an Italian medical team has been sent to support them.
facts.sourceQuote: According to the ministry, the 11 injured parties were receiving treatment and none were in a life-threatening condition. It has sent an Italian medical team to support them.

facts.claim: EUFOR stated the crash occurred during routine training in the Gorice area of the Brčko District, near the Serbian border, about 180 kilometres from Sarajevo.
facts.sourceQuote: EUFOR stated that the helicopter went down during routine training in the Gorice area of the Brčko District, near the border with Serbia and about 180 kilometers (112 miles) from Sarajevo.

facts.claim: The cause is not yet established; both the Italian Ministry of Defence and EUFOR have opened investigations, and Italy’s ambassador said the accident appeared to have happened during take‑off.
facts.sourceQuote: The cause of the accident has not yet been established. The Italian Ministry of Defense declared that investigators had already begun working to reconstruct what happened, while EUFOR said it is conducting its own full investigation. Italy’s ambassador to Bosnia and Herzegovina told Italian media that the accident appeared to have happened during takeoff.
